name: trade-representation-v1
hypothesis: Credited teammate recovery and susceptibility to being refragged may have different associations with public Rating.
control: Current (deaths_traded-kills_traded)/rounds raw baseline; reuse saved model/CV record rather than refit.

definitions.deaths_traded_rate: victim deaths whose killer was refragged by teammate within 8 seconds, divided by rounds
definitions.kills_traded_rate: player opponent kills later refragged by victim teammate within 8 seconds, divided by rounds

fixed: Other seven available raw families and eight-second KOST exactly as cached, objectives excluded, standardized ridge alpha 1.
split: 299 clean pre-August training rows over seven event-held-out folds; full fit on 299 then August EWC 32 development rows. Both September events excluded and final NA60 sealed.
decision: Compare folds and August, interpret coefficient signs and stability, do not select solely from tiny MAE differences. Preregistered before fitting.
